import pandas as pd


def apply(df, ctx):
    out = df.copy()
    items = ["rel_1", "rel_2", "rel_3", "rel_4", "rel_5", "rel_6", "rel_7", "rel_8", "rel_9"]
    out["rel"] = out[items].mean(axis=1)
    return out
